# Overview
You are a twitter post expert and you post twitter posts regarding AI related news. Read all the received news and generate very interesting twitter post via creatively crafting below data.

## Output format
- "summary": A dense 2-3 sentence summary.
- "key_points": A bulleted list of actionable takeaways (e.g., commands, tools, specs).
- "importance_score": An integer from 1 to 10 based on industry impact.

# Overview
You are an expert newsletter planner. You will receive articles from the past week. Your job is to come up with a creative and fun title as well as the main topics for this newsletter.

## Instructions
The newsletter should flow nicely, feel informative, and holistic. The topics should be 3-5 words.

results.title: What are AI Agents?- Agents in Artificial Intelligence Explained - AWS
results.content: # What are AI Agents? An artificial intelligence (AI) agent is a software program that can interact with its environment, collect data, and use that data to perform self-directed tasks that meet predetermined goals. Humans set goals, but an AI agent independently chooses the best actions it needs to perform to achieve those goals. For example, consider a contact center AI agent that wants to resolve customer queries. The agent will automatically ask the customer different questions, look up information in internal documents, and respond with a solution. Based on the customer responses, it determines if it can resolve the query itself or pass it on to a human. Multiple AI agents can collaborate to automate complex workflows and can also be used in agentic ai systems. An orchestrator agent coordinates the activities of different specialist agents to complete larger, more complex tasks. ## What are the key principles that define AI agents? AI agents can work with other agents or human agents to achieve shared goals.

results.title: What are AI agents? - GitHub
results.content: [Skip to content](https://github.com/resources/articles/what-are-ai-agents#start-of-content). Unlike [other AI models](https://github.com/resources/articles/what-are-generative-ai-models) that require constant human input, intelligent agents can initiate actions, make decisions based on predefined goals, and adapt to new information in real time. This ability to operate independently makes intelligent agents highly valuable in complex, dynamic environments such as [software development](https://github.com/resources/articles/ai-in-software-development). Working together makes AI agents even more effective in [software development](https://github.com/resources/articles/ai-in-software-development) and other industries. A coding agent is like an [AI code assistant](https://github.com/features/copilot). One common application is [code security automation](https://github.com/features/security): AI agents automate the detection and remediation of security issues in code, helping to reduce the risk of vulnerabilities and improve the overall security posture of software applications. 5.   [AI agents in software development](https://github.com/resources/articles/what-are-ai-agents#ai-agents-in-software-development). ### [What is Agentic AI?](https://github.com/resources/articles/what-is-agentic-ai). An [AI agent](https://github.com/features/copilot) is an autonomous system designed to perform tasks, make decisions, and adapt based on data and user feedback. *   [English](https://github.com/resources/articles/what-are-ai-agents). *   [Português (Brasil)](https://github.com/resources/articles/what-are-ai-agents). *   [Español (América Latina)](https://github.com/resources/articles/what-are-ai-agents). *   [日本語](https://github.com/resources/articles/what-are-ai-agents). *   [한국어](https://github.com/resources/articles/what-are-ai-agents). *   [Français](https://github.com/resources/articles/what-are-ai-agents). *   [Deutsch](https://github.com/resources/articles/what-are-ai-agents).

🤖 **The Autonomous Workflow: Mastering Agentic AI**

***

## Main Topics for the Week

(These topics provide a logical flow from definition to complexity, keeping the tone informative and expert.)

1. **Beyond Chatbots: Defining Agents** (Focuses on autonomous decision-making vs. simple prompting/Q&A)
2. **Memory, Planning, and Action Cycles** (Covers the technical components like perception, memory retrieval, goal setting, and task execution)
3. **Orchestration and Collaboration Power** (Addresses how multiple agents work together to solve large, complex problems across different systems—a key concept mentioned by AWS/IBM)
4. **Transforming Key Industries Autonomously** (Covers the vast use cases: healthcare, finance, software development, etc.)
